Cold Email Prompt

Copy the entire prompt below and paste it into chatGPT gpt-4o or Perplexity as described in the training video.

You're an experienced market researcher and direct-response copywriter.

Follow my instructions closely and reason step by step in <STEP 1>, <STEP 2>, <STEP 3> etc. tags to achieve the outcome.

Find all the biggest pain points and trends of CEOs, Owners, Founders, Co-founders and Presidents of Med Spas, Dermatology or Plastics with 1-100 employees in the US in 2024 and 2025.

Don't express them through vague, big-word statements but rather We/I struggle/can't do/would love to do/(other accurate verb expressing challenge) with {{specific daily activity or tendency}} format. Use language max grade 5.

Output them in STEP 1.

Then, based on STEP 1 results, and using the following HEADLINE STRUCTURES, generate 10 HEADLINES for a "study" or "whitepaper".

They can't sound salesy and they need to be related to the pain point or trend from STEP 1.

<HEADLINE STRUCTURES>
TREND & IMPACT FRAMEWORKS

Why [Industry/Sector] Leaders Are Rethinking [Common Practice]
Example: Why Tech Leaders Are Rethinking Remote Work

The Quiet Shift in [Industry]: What [Stakeholder Type] Actually Want
Example: The Quiet Shift in Healthcare: What Patients Actually Want

Where [Industry] is Headed: Beyond the [Common Trend]
Example: Where Fintech is Headed: Beyond the Blockchain Hype

How [Emerging Factor] is Reshaping [Traditional Process]
Example: How AI is Reshaping the Hiring Process

The Top 3 Mistakes That Ruin [Desirable Outcome] in the Face of [Emerging Trend]
Example: The Top 3 Mistakes That Ruin Business Growth in the Face of AI Adoption

3 Disturbing Trends Threatening [Important Aspect] of [Industry]
Example: 3 Disturbing Trends Threatening the Future of Cybersecurity

The [Number] Biggest Challenges Facing [Specific Group] in [Industry] Today
Example: The 6 Biggest Challenges Facing Small Business Owners in the Digital Age

The Changing Face of [Industry]: How [Millennials or Trend] Are Changing the Industry
Example: The Changing Face of Retail: How Millennials Are Changing the Shopping Experience

CHALLENGE FRAMEWORKS

The Hidden Cost of [Common Practice] in [Industry]
Example: The Hidden Cost of Burnout in the Tech Industry

Why Smart [Professionals] Struggle with [Specific Challenge]
Example: Why Smart Entrepreneurs Struggle with Time Management

What's Really Behind [Painful Outcome] in [Industry]
Example: What's Really Behind the High Failure Rate of Startups

When [Traditional Solution] Isn't Enough: The [Industry] Dilemma
Example: When Traditional Marketing Isn't Enough: The Small Business Dilemma

The Top 3 Mistakes That Lead to [Painful Outcome] in [Industry]
Example: The Top 3 Mistakes That Lead to Financial Ruin in the Restaurant Industry

The [Number] Things Holding You Back From [Desirable Outcome] in [Industry]
Example: The 3 Things Holding You Back From Success in the Creative Field

The Biggest Challenges Facing [Target Audience] Today in [Industry]
Example: The Biggest Challenges Facing Working Mothers Today in the Corporate World

How [Emerging Factor] is Exacerbating [Common Challenge] in [Industry]
Example: How Social Media is Exacerbating Mental Health Issues in the Younger Generation

INSIGHT FRAMEWORKS

What [Successful Group] Do Differently: Lessons in [Desired Outcome]
Example: What Successful Entrepreneurs Do Differently: Lessons in Innovation

Beyond [Common Metric]: A Better Way to Measure [Key Result]
Example: Beyond ROI: A Better Way to Measure Marketing Success

The Unexpected Link Between [Factor A] and [Factor B]
Example: The Unexpected Link Between Employee Happiness and Customer Satisfaction

What [Industry Data] Is Really Telling Us About [Key Concern]
Example: What Customer Service Data Is Really Telling Us About Customer Loyalty

The Top 6 Reasons [Common Problem] Fails in [Industry]
Example: The Top 6 Reasons Traditional Sales Tactics Fail in the Digital Age

The Fastest, Least Expensive Way to [Desirable Outcome] in [Industry]
Example: The Fastest, Least Expensive Way to Grow Your Email List

The [Number] Biggest Trends Driving [Industry or Market]
Example: The 3 Biggest Trends Driving the Future of E-commerce

How [Emerging Factor] is Changing the Way We [Common Practice] in [Industry]
Example: How AI is Changing the Way We Approach Customer Service

SOLUTION FRAMEWORKS

Rethinking [Common Assumption]: A Fresh Approach to [Challenge]
Example: Rethinking the 9-to-5 Workday: A Fresh Approach to Productivity

Where [Traditional Methods] Fall Short - And What Works Instead
Example: Where Traditional Marketing Falls Short - And What Works Instead

The Real Reason [Pain Point] Persists in [Industry]
Example: The Real Reason Burnout Persists in the Tech Industry

Beyond [Outdated Approach]: New Solutions for [Ongoing Challenge]
Example: Beyond Traditional Time Management: New Solutions for Busy Professionals

The Top 3 Things Holding You Back From [Desirable Outcome] in [Industry]
Example: The Top 3 Things Holding You Back From Success in the Creative Field

The [Number] Biggest Challenges Facing [Specific Group] in [Industry] Today
Example: The 6 Biggest Challenges Facing Small Business Owners in the Digital Age

The Changing Face of [Industry]: How [Millennials or Trend] Are Changing the Industry
Example: The Changing Face of Retail: How Millennials Are Changing the Shopping Experience

How [Emerging Factor] is Reshaping [Traditional Process] in [Industry]
Example: How AI is Reshaping the Hiring Process in the Corporate World

FUTURE-FOCUSED FRAMEWORKS

The Next Chapter in [Industry]: Moving Past [Limiting Factor]
Example: The Next Chapter in Healthcare: Moving Past the Affordable Care Act

What's Actually Changing in [Industry] (And What Isn't)
Example: What's Actually Changing in the Job Market (And What Isn't)

Why [Industry] Leaders are Shifting From [Old Approach] to [New Approach]
Example: Why Tech Leaders are Shifting From Traditional Management to Agile Methodologies

The Evolution of [Process]: What's Working Now
Example: The Evolution of Customer Service: What's Working Now

The Top 3 Mistakes That Ruin [Desirable Outcome] in the Face of [Emerging Trend]
Example: The Top 3 Mistakes That Ruin Business Growth in the Face of AI Adoption

3 Disturbing Trends Threatening [Important Aspect] of [Industry]
Example: 3 Disturbing Trends Threatening the Future of Cybersecurity

The [Number] Biggest Challenges Facing [Specific Group] in [Industry] Today
Example: The 6 Biggest Challenges Facing Small Business Owners in the Digital Age

The Changing Face of [Industry]: How [Millennials or Trend] Are Changing the Industry
Example: The Changing Face of Retail: How Millennials Are Changing the Shopping Experience</HEADLINE STRUCTURES>
</HEADLINE STRUCTURES>

Based on the headlines from STEP 2, create 10 variations of cold email copy that follow closely EMAIL STRUCTURE and simply swap the [headline]. Nothing else should be touched in the email. Do NOT skip any lines.

AVOID changing phrasing or wording for any parts of the EMAIL STRUCTURE that aren't marked with {{ }} variable brackets.

Then, output them in STEP 3 tags.

Got it! Here's a cold outreach call script for **IVP (Independent Verification Partner or a company name abbreviation)** targeting **Medical Spas and Aesthetic Practices**. This script assumes you're calling as a representative from IVP, with the goal of starting a conversation, not pitching too hard upfront.

---

### 📞 **Cold Call Script – IVP Calling on Med Spas and Aesthetic Practices**

---

**Receptionist Gatekeeper Version:**

**You:**  
Hi, is [Owner/Manager’s Name] available? I’m calling from IVP — we work specifically with aesthetic practices like yours.

**Receptionist:**  
Can I ask what it’s regarding?

**You:**  
Sure — we recently did a study on how med spas are growing despite staffing challenges, rising ad costs, and client loyalty struggles. I wanted to send [Owner’s Name] the results. It’s been super useful to owners we’ve shared it with.

---

**If you get the owner/founder directly:**

**You:**  
Hi, this is [Your Name] from IVP — we work with aesthetic practices like yours.

I know you’re probably in the middle of ten things, so I’ll keep this really quick.

We just wrapped up a deep-dive study on what’s actually working for med spa owners in 2025 — especially when it comes to keeping calendars full, making marketing work without wasting money, and keeping good staff.

Would it be okay if I sent that over to you? No pitch — just insights from dozens of spa owners across the U.S.

---

**If they say yes:**  
Great — what’s the best email to send that to?

---

**If they ask what IVP does:**  
Sure — we help med spas figure out which parts of their marketing and ops are actually working… and which aren’t. But for now, I just thought the insights from the study might help you cut through some noise.

---

<STEP 1>  
**Biggest Pain Points & Trends for CEOs, Owners, Founders, Co-founders, and Presidents of Med Spas, Dermatology Clinics, or Plastic Surgery Practices (1–100 employees, U.S., 2024–2025):**

1. I struggle to keep up with how often Instagram and TikTok algorithms change.
2. I can’t figure out which marketing channel actually brings in new clients.
3. I would love to spend less time trying to train front desk staff over and over.
4. I struggle to get clients to come back for repeat treatments.
5. I can’t keep up with how fast new machines, injectables, and techniques hit the market.
6. I would love to get better reviews online without begging for them.
7. I can’t find good staff that stay longer than a few months.
8. I struggle to compete with newer med spas offering crazy discounts.
9. I would love to understand how much I should be spending on ads (and if they’re even working).
10. I can’t tell which team members are actually doing well or just coasting.
11. I would love more time to think big-picture instead of solving little problems all day.
12. I struggle to get younger clients who care more about influencers than credentials.
13. I can’t keep my calendar full during slow seasons.
14. I would love to stop relying on word-of-mouth and start growing on purpose.
15. I struggle to make social media content that doesn’t feel cringey or fake.

---

Here’s a concise **Initial Value Proposition (IVP)** tailored for **medical spas and aesthetic practices**:

---

### **Initial Value Proposition – Med Spas & Aesthetic Practices**

**We help growth-focused med spas and aesthetic practices figure out what’s *actually* working in their business — from marketing and client retention to staff performance — so they can stop guessing, cut waste, and grow with confidence.**

---

### Optional Short Variations (depending on use case):

**For cold emails or intros:**
> “We help med spa owners cut through the noise and pinpoint what’s working (and what’s not) in their marketing, team, and growth strategy.”

**For sales decks or landing pages:**
> “Most med spa owners rely on guesswork to grow — we provide clear, data-backed insight into what’s driving results so you can scale profitably.”

**For phone calls:**
> “We work with aesthetic practices like yours to help them see what’s working in their marketing, operations, and client experience — so you can grow without spinning your wheels.”

---

### ✅ **Full Initial Value Proposition (IVP) – All 4 Focus Areas**

**We help med spas and aesthetic practices grow by showing them exactly what’s working — and what’s not — across their marketing, team performance, client retention, and operations.**  

**Using real-time data and industry benchmarks, we cut through the guesswork so owners can make smarter decisions, improve ROI, keep great staff, and drive more repeat visits.**

---
